WITH RECURSIVE candidates(barcode_id, value, high_value) AS (
  SELECT barcode_id, MAX(0, low_value), high_value
  FROM barcodes
  WHERE MAX(0, low_value) <= high_value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT barcode_id, value + 1, high_value
  FROM candidates
  WHERE value < high_value
)
SELECT c.barcode_id, MIN(c.value) AS missing_value
FROM candidates AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM remainder_checks AS r
  WHERE r.barcode_id = c.barcode_id
    AND c.value % r.modulus <> r.required_remainder
)
GROUP BY c.barcode_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
ORDER BY c.barcode_id ASC

  FROM call_batches

  SELECT a.batch_code || ',' || b.batch_code,
         a.outlay_cents + b.outlay_cents,
